profile.headline: Lead of Engineering and Cloud Infra
profile.summary:
Dedication, resourcefulness, knowledge and passion. I believe that these are key traits of good Software Engineers that I strive to make my name synonymous with. I've spent the majority of my life working with computers on the fronts of both hardware and software and take pride in being a valuable member of any team. 

Aside from a well founded knowledge in computer hardware and other aspects of IT, I am a very proficient, full-stack Software Engineer using the .NET framework, including C#, ASP.NET and Entity Framework. 

My key traits include adaptability, dedication and my ability to learn and apply new concepts at a business oriented level. Over the years that I've been working with computers I've worked with many different languages and technologies, from Pascal on Delphi 6 to Node.js, Python, Lua, and C++. I have a very intense drive for the work that I do, and take enjoyment in learning new ways to apply my skills.

I'm very happy to connect and communicate with others, so don't be shy about reaching out if you're interested!

projects.title: TISFAT Zero
projects.description:
TISFAT Zero is a complete remake of an outdated animation software known as TISFAT. Originally a college project, TISFAT Zero became a powerful animation suite for bone animation, using Inverse Kinematics and keyframes to pose and animate the figures.

The original creator of TISFAT, Dirk 'NoshBar' De La Hunt stopped development of the software and released the source code in mid/late 2012-early 2013. From there, I built upon the existing Inverse Kinematics algorithm and began building my own program from the ground up.

In it's current state, it is functional but inefficient. It is currently a side project and is being brought up to date with optimized code using the experience that I gained writing the program.
